title_jp: {雪だるま|ゆきだるま}{作戦|さくせん}
context: Tuesday 5 January: アルちゃん keeps the promise from his {年賀状|ねんがじょう} and builds a snowman with {颯太|そうた} before the winter break ends. It doesn't go to plan, and the two of them tell why.
scene: Winter break is nearly over. You and {颯太|そうた} finally build the snowman you promised. Twice.

phrases.jp: {重すぎた|おもすぎた}せいで、{折れちゃった|おれちゃった|to snap, break|3}。
phrases.en: It was too heavy, so it snapped.
phrases.note: 〜せいで blames the cause for a bad result.

phrases.jp: {手伝って|てつだって}くれたおかげで、{早く|はやく}{終わった|おわった}よ。
phrases.en: Thanks to your help, we finished quickly.
phrases.note: 〜おかげで credits the cause for a good result.

phrases.jp: {玄関|げんかん}を{開けた|あけた}とたん、{颯太|そうた}が{飛びついて|とびついて|to jump at, leap onto|3}きた。
phrases.en: The moment I opened the front door, {颯太|そうた} leapt at me.

phrases.jp: {日陰|ひかげ|shade|3}なので、なかなか{溶けません|とけません|to melt|3}。
phrases.en: It's in the shade, so it hardly melts.

phrases.jp: {寒い|さむい}{中|なか}、ありがとうございました。
phrases.en: Thank you for coming out in this cold.
phrases.note: {寒|さむ}い{中|なか} = 'in the cold': a set way to thank someone who came out in winter.

dialogue_setting: The 田中 orchard and the back of the barn, a sunny, freezing Tuesday. アルちゃん and {颯太|そうた} tell the story that evening.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {冬休み|ふゆやすみ}もあと{少し|すこし}。{今日|きょう}は{颯太|そうた}と、{年賀状|ねんがじょう}で{約束|やくそく}した{雪だるま|ゆきだるま}を{作った|つくった}。
dialogue.en: Winter break is almost over. Today {颯太|そうた} and I built the snowman I'd promised on my New Year card.

dialogue.speaker: 颯太
dialogue.jp: {雪|ゆき}がサラサラすぎて、なかなか{固まらなかった|かたまらなかった|to harden, set|3}。だから{水|みず}をかけたんだ。
dialogue.en: The snow was too powdery and wouldn't pack. So we poured water on it.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {頭|あたま}を{乗せた|のせた}とたん、{首|くび}のところで{折れて|おれて|to snap, break|3}しまった。{重すぎた|おもすぎた}せいだ。
dialogue.en: The moment we put the head on, it snapped at the neck. It was too heavy.

dialogue.speaker: 颯太
dialogue.jp: そこへじいちゃんが{来て|きて}、{日陰|ひかげ|shade|3}なら{溶けにくい|とけにくい|to melt|3}って{教えて|おしえて}くれた。
dialogue.en: Then Grandpa came and told us it melts less in the shade.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: だから{納屋|なや|barn, shed|3}の{裏|うら|back, behind|3}に{作り直した|つくりなおした|to make again, redo|3}。{今度|こんど}は{頭|あたま}を{小さく|ちいさく}した。
dialogue.en: So we rebuilt it behind the barn. This time we made the head smaller.

dialogue.speaker: 颯太
dialogue.jp: {完成|かんせい|completion|3}！アルちゃんの{眼鏡|めがね}もかけた。{寒い|さむい}{中|なか}、{頑張った|がんばった|to do your best|4}おかげだね！
dialogue.en: Done! We put アルちゃん's glasses on it too. All thanks to working hard in the cold!

listening.intro: While you're behind the barn, {恵子|けいこ}さん leaves a message.

lines.jp: アルちゃん、{恵子|けいこ}です。{由美|ゆみ}の{都合|つごう}で、{颯太|そうた}は{今夜|こんや}{長野|ながの}に{帰る|かえる}ことになったの。
lines.en: アルちゃん, it's {恵子|けいこ}. Because of {由美|ゆみ}'s schedule, {颯太|そうた} is going back to {長野|ながの} tonight.

lines.jp: {夕方|ゆうがた}5{時|じ}に{迎えに|むかえに}{来る|くる}って。それまでに{帰って|かえって}きてね。
lines.en: She's coming to pick him up at 5. Come back before then.

listening.question: {颯太|そうた}は、いつ{長野|ながの}に{帰りますか|かえりますか}。
listening.explain: {今夜|こんや}{長野|ながの}に{帰|かえ}る: {由美|ゆみ} comes for him at 5 this evening.

grammar.form: {動詞|どうし}た{形|けい} + とたん(に) ({乗|の}せる → {乗|の}せたとたん, {開|あ}ける → {開|あ}けたとたん)
grammar.explanation: Review: the instant A happened, B happened, usually a surprise. B is a fact, not your plan or request. Compare 〜てすぐ (neutral 'right after') and 〜たびに ('every time').

examples.jp: {鍋|なべ}をテーブルに{置いた|おいた}とたん、{颯太|そうた}が{走って|はしって}きた。
examples.en: The second I put the hot pot on the table, {颯太|そうた} came running.

examples.jp: チャイムが{鳴った|なった}とたん、{生徒|せいと}たちは{教室|きょうしつ}を{出た|でた}。
examples.en: The moment the bell rang, the students left the classroom.

quiz.question: {頭|あたま}を＿＿とたん、{雪だるま|ゆきだるま}が{崩れた|くずれた|to collapse|3}。
quiz.en: The moment we put the head on, the snowman collapsed.
quiz.explain: とたん follows the た-form: {乗|の}せたとたん.

quiz_more.question: {窓|まど}を{開けた|あけた}＿＿、{冷たい|つめたい}{風|かぜ}が{入って|はいって}きた。
quiz_more.en: The moment I opened the window, cold wind came in.
quiz_more.explain: A sudden result of one moment: とたん. たびに is 'every time'.

quiz_more.question: {家|いえ}を{出た|でた}とたん、＿＿。
quiz_more.en: The moment I left the house, ＿＿.
options: 傘を持っていこうと思う
quiz_more.explain: After とたん: something that happened, not a plan or a request.

kanji.meaning: caution: snow falling from the roof
kanji.where: A tin sign on the corner of the {納屋|なや} roof, right above where you first wanted to build.
kanji.breakdown: {落雪|らくせつ}: 落 fall + 雪 snow → snow sliding off a roof; {注意|ちゅうい}: pay attention.
kanji.related: {雪下|ゆきお}ろし = clearing snow off a roof.

tip.title: Two balls, not three
tip.body: A Japanese {雪|ゆき}だるま is usually two balls, like a Daruma doll, while the Western snowman has three. In snow country, never build or stand under a roof edge: heavy snow slides off without warning, which is what {落雪注意|らくせつちゅうい} signs are for.

challenge.prompt: {恵子|けいこ}さん on the family LINE: 「{雪|ゆき}だるま、どうして{納屋|なや|barn, shed|3}の{裏|うら|back, behind|3}に{作った|つくった}の？」 Explain why, politely.
challenge.hint: {日陰|ひかげ}だと + {溶|と}けにくい + から
challenge.model_answer: {日陰|ひかげ|shade|3}だと{溶けにくい|とけにくい|to melt|3}から、{納屋|なや|barn, shed|3}の{裏|うら|back, behind|3}に{作りました|つくりました}。
challenge.explanation: {日陰|ひかげ}だと = 'if it's in the shade'. {溶|と}け + にくい = hard to melt. から gives the reason before the result, and {作|つく}りました keeps it polite for {恵子|けいこ}さん.

vocab.note: {雪|ゆき}が{固|かた}まる. Also 'to freeze up' with nerves.
Long things: branches, bones, pencils. Transitive: {折|お}る.
{日|ひ} sun + {陰|かげ} shadow. Opposite: {日向|ひなた}.
Snow, ice, chocolate. {溶|と}けにくい = slow to melt.
{家|いえ}の{裏|うら} = behind the house. Opposite: {表|おもて}.
Stem + {直|なお}す = do again: {書|か}き{直|なお}す.
{完成|かんせい}！ = done! {完成|かんせい}する = be finished.
{頑張|がんば}って！ = good luck, go for it.

kanji_study.parts: 衣 clothing split open, with 里 inside → the inner lining of a garment: the back, the hidden side.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 表 (front, surface): 表 is a whole garment with no 里 inside.

kanji_study.parts: 者 person + ⻏ town (on the right) → a town where crowds of people gather: the capital.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 部 (part, section): 部 has 立 and 口 on the left; 都 has 者.
